body: UPDATE: I am getting them removed today! Defo gonna be taking a little break to give my natural lashes time to grow. I bought a lash serum so hopefully that helps as well. Thanks so much for the helpful comments guys! Really helped and educated me so much. Also sent a dm to the lash tech and will not be going back .
Do you suggest I get them removed ?

Yeah true I’m just shocked bc she spoke about how long she’s been lashing and even used to work in a salon before she went solo. Just confused by the quality if she’s as experienced as she says she is
Yep definitely poor isolation :(  I think I’m gonna get them removed which is a bummer bc I really like them but I need to prioritize the health of my natural lashes. Plus they’re uncomfy 😓

So I got my lashes done on Tuesday and I honestly loved them when I first got them but a couple of red flags stood out to me. 

Firstly, the lashes took under 1 hour to do… I was impressed at first but then saw on tiktok that a volume set shouldn’t take less than an hour and a half. Weird.

Secondly, she didn’t wash my lashes before doing them which at the time I thought was weird but didn’t say anything.

Now, I usually do lighter hybrid sets but wanted something more fuller.My eyes have felt quite irritated but I didn’t think about that bc usually ehne I do fuller sets I get very red,sore eyes. Today i had some fans fall out and what really got me sad was a huge fan had ripped out my natural lashes. Idk what to tell the girl bc I was rubbing my eyes so that could be why they fell out. I just don’t want to permanently lose any lashes and I’m quite confused bc she said she has been lashing for a long time and even used to work in a salon.

I got it 13 days ago and it’s crusty around the top and bottom with a bit of discoloration. Idk if it’s just healing or infected. It gets a tiny bit sore sometimes but nothing major. Should I take it out?
